reviews.comment: Thermodynamics is naturally a tough subject, but he makes it fun. I had him when classes were online, and based on feedback from friends who had taken the class the previous year (in-person), the lecture content was the same. The exams are devilishly tough, but you can get good grades if you understand the subject. Grades generously too.
